rules.title: npm cache
rules.reclaim: Packages are re-downloaded on demand.

rules.title: npx cache
rules.reclaim: One-off CLIs are fetched again on next use.

rules.title: uv cache
rules.reclaim: Python wheels are re-downloaded.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.reclaim: Python wheels are re-downloaded.

rules.title: pnpm store
rules.reclaim: Unreferenced packages are pruned; others re-download.

rules.title: Playwright browsers
rules.reclaim: Run npx playwright install to restore.

rules.title: Codex sandbox runtimes
rules.reclaim: Re-downloaded on the next sandboxed run.

rules.title: Xcode DerivedData
rules.reclaim: Next build is slower; nothing is lost.

rules.title: Homebrew download cache
rules.reclaim: Downloaded bottles and cache files only. Installed versions are untouched; run brew cleanup separately.

rules.title: Spotify cache
rules.reclaim: Artwork and audio re-stream. Offline downloads are lost.

rules.title: Brave caches
rules.reclaim: First page loads are slower. Logins and tabs are untouched.

rules.title: Chrome cache
rules.reclaim: First page loads are slower. Logins and tabs are untouched.

rules.title: Codex app cache
rules.reclaim: Regenerated by the ChatGPT app.

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.reclaim: Yarn re-downloads packages on demand.

rules.title: Bun install cache
rules.reclaim: Packages are re-downloaded on the next install.

rules.title: Deno cache
rules.reclaim: Modules are re-fetched on the next run.

rules.title: Go build and module cache
rules.reclaim: Go re-downloads modules and rebuilds packages.

rules.title: Cargo registry cache
rules.reclaim: Crates are re-downloaded on the next build.

rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.reclaim: Gradle re-downloads dependencies and wrappers.

rules.title: Maven repository cache
rules.reclaim: Maven may hold unpublished, locally installed artifacts here; Maven cannot download those again.

rules.title: SwiftPM cache
rules.reclaim: SwiftPM re-resolves packages on the next build.

rules.title: CocoaPods cache
rules.reclaim: Pods are re-downloaded by the next install.

rules.title: Puppeteer browsers
rules.reclaim: Puppeteer downloads browsers again when needed.

rules.title: Cypress cache
rules.reclaim: Cypress re-downloads its binary on the next run.

rules.title: Electron download cache
rules.reclaim: Electron downloads are fetched again when needed.

rules.title: VS Code caches
rules.reclaim: Caches rebuild; settings, extensions, and history stay.

rules.title: Cursor caches
rules.reclaim: Caches rebuild; chat history and settings stay.

rules.title: Steam data (uninstalled app)
rules.reclaim: Only for machines where Steam is no longer installed.

rules.title: Cursor data (uninstalled app)
rules.reclaim: Only for machines where Cursor is no longer installed. Removes chat history.

rules.title: Hugging Face model cache
rules.reclaim: Downloaded models are removed and re-download later.

rules.title: Old installers in Downloads
rules.reclaim: Installer files older than 30 days; re-downloadable.
